2. Hotel content and rate parity — Sofia
3. GDS contract renewal — Daniel
4. Data platform costs — Kenji
5. Open questions

Alex, could you take topic 1? You know the RouteDesk numbers best. Please confirm by Wednesday so I can send the invite to the vendors.
